selectionMethod: Visual content review of the actual Hayale originals through private discovery previews, checked against earlier Hayale source evidence. No filename-order, size, random or modulo selection.
permissionBasis: User approved these fifteen original Hayale image roles and the original soundtrack for the defined GCP-only promotional workflow.

logo.selectionEvidence: Original cream square logo with burgundy floral monogram, exact Hebrew lettering, English HAYALE FLOWERS line and circular border. Same original is reused for opening and closing; no recreated lettering.

customer-01.selectionEvidence: Actual adult customer wearing sunglasses and a light outfit, holding a large round red-rose bouquet with gold ribbon at the shop entrance. Preserve face, complete bouquet, clothing and original context.

customer-02.selectionEvidence: Actual adult customer in a blue outfit and sunglasses, holding two distinct mixed bouquets inside the shop. Preserve his face, both bouquets and clothing. Existing mirror reflections belong to the source; no invented additional people.

customer-03.selectionEvidence: Actual adult customer with short blond hair in a striped top, holding purple-and-white flowers and a tall wrapped plant with red ribbon inside the shop. Preserve her recognizable face, both gifts and the original framing.

exterior-01.selectionEvidence: Wide street-side facade: black awning, actual entrance, pavement and plant racks on both sides. Establishes the real shop architecture; preserve existing poles, reflections and signage instead of inventing replacements.

exterior-02.selectionEvidence: Distinct oblique pavement-side view along the glazed storefront, illuminated flower sign, real window plants and entrance-side passage. Provides a closer exterior approach rather than duplicating the wide facade image.

product-01.selectionEvidence: Tight hero view of an actual pink-and-purple gerbera and pale mixed-flower bouquet in pink wrapping. Preserve the existing arrangement and visible petal geometry; do not crop further into the bouquet.

product-02.selectionEvidence: Actual orange-gerbera and cream-flower arrangement in purple patterned wrapping. Distinct product and color composition from product-01; recognizable flower positions and wrapper remain the visual anchor.

product-03.selectionEvidence: Actual yellow sunflower bouquet with dark centers, green filler and printed-paper wrapping. Distinct third product, with a warm closing product palette; existing printed wrapper must not become new promotional text.

vibe-01.selectionEvidence: Deep purple lisianthus flowers and buds with layered stems and soft background focus. Selected for floral atmosphere, color and restrained depth rather than as a packaged product hero.

vibe-02.selectionEvidence: Pale yellow and blush orchid blossoms against a softly defocused shop background. Reuses the original orchid-detail subject established in the earlier Hayale creative brief, preserving delicate petal structure.

vibe-03.selectionEvidence: Actual layered green leaves and stems in soft side light. Provides a quiet natural-texture atmosphere between the last product hero and interior tour, without adding another bouquet or invented scenery.

tour-01.selectionEvidence: Wide actual interior with hanging greenery and orchids in the foreground, floral buckets below and wall-mounted glass shelves. Establishes the compact shop layout; preserve shelf heights and architecture.

tour-02.selectionEvidence: Different, lower frontal interior view across the real multi-level bouquet display, floor buckets, left plant stand and rear orchid shelf. Gives a spatial view of the merchandising arrangement rather than another isolated product close-up.

tour-03.selectionEvidence: Distinct upward oblique view of the shop's actual glass display shelves, colored planters, decorative vases and orchids. Cloud-only top 6000x3375 composition crop from the 6000x4000 original keeps the principal shelves and excludes the lower-right CCTV-screen edge. Rejected the separate CCTV-dominated DSC0057 candidate.

soundtrack.provenance: Original approved Hayale soundtrack bound in preserved run 344ab3d2444c and the later 64-second edit. The original byte hash was rechecked during this source selection.

arrangement.basis: Reuse the explicit documented interior eight-beat motif arrangement: retain the original intro and natural ending; repeat the matched interior phrase rather than blindly appending the opening. Five-millisecond in-place join ramps; no overlap, silence padding or time stretch. Render anew in GCP from the original soundtrack.
